description: CLI Provider Abstraction Layer - Make OMX truly agnostic to the underlying execution CLI (codex, claude, opencode) via a CliProvider interface and provider registry

userStories.title: Define the CliProvider interface and capability types
userStories.description: As a contributor adding a new CLI backend, I need a single interface that tells me exactly what to implement so that OMX works with my CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: CliProvider interface defined in src/providers/types.ts
Interface covers all 6 coupling layers: config home, config format, TUI contract, argument translation, prompt/guidance injection, binary resolution
CliProviderCapabilities type declares optional features: tui mode ('full' | 'headless'), queue mode, adaptive retry, viewport detection
TuiContract type defines: submitKeyPresses (number), supportsQueueMode (boolean), supportsAdaptiveRetry (boolean)
LaunchOpts type defines: bypassApprovals (boolean), model (string), initialPrompt (string), extraArgs (string[])
OmxConfig type defines provider-agnostic config: mcpServers, reasoningEffort, developerInstructions, model
Each method/property has JSDoc documenting its purpose and contract
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build the provider registry
userStories.description: As the OMX runtime, I need to look up the correct provider by name so that all CLI-specific behavior is routed through the right implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: ProviderRegistry class in src/providers/registry.ts
register(name, provider), get(name), list(), has(name) methods
get() throws descriptive error listing available providers when name is not registered
A default global registry instance is exported
An initBuiltinProviders() function registers codex, claude, opencode providers
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: CodexProvider - core behavior (paths, binary, args, TUI, guidance)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the existing Codex-specific behavior extracted into a provider implementation for paths, binary resolution, launch args, TUI contract, and guidance injection.
acceptanceCriteria: CodexProvider in src/providers/codex.ts implements CliProvider
configHome() returns ~/.codex/
projectConfigDir() returns .codex/
guidanceFile() returns AGENTS.md
binaryName returns 'codex'
buildLaunchArgs() includes --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox when bypass requested
TUI contract: submitKeyPresses=2, supportsQueueMode=true, supportsAdaptiveRetry=true
detectTrustPrompt() matches 'Do you trust the contents of this directory?'
detectViewport() matches box-drawing chars pattern
dismissTrustPromptKeys() returns the correct key sequence
skillsDir() returns ~/.codex/skills/, promptsDir() returns ~/.codex/prompts/
Provider registered in initBuiltinProviders()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: CodexProvider - config writer (TOML generation)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the CodexProvider to generate native config.toml from the provider-agnostic OmxConfig type.
acceptanceCriteria: CodexProvider.writeConfig(config: OmxConfig) generates ~/.codex/config.toml
MCP servers written as [mcp_servers.omx_<name>] TOML sections with command, args, enabled, timeout
model_reasoning_effort key set from config
developer_instructions key set from config
Marker comments preserved: 'oh-my-codex (OMX) Shared MCP Registry Sync'
Existing user config outside OMX markers is preserved on merge
Unit test: generated TOML matches expected Codex config format
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Headless fallback mode for TUI interaction
userStories.description: As a provider author, I need a way to declare that my CLI doesn't have a TUI so OMX falls back to pipe-based interaction.
acceptanceCriteria: CliProviderCapabilities.tui accepts 'full' or 'headless'
When tui is 'headless', buildWorkerSubmitPlan returns: single key press, no queue, no retry
Headless mode skips viewport detection (detectViewport returns false)
Headless mode skips trust prompt handling (detectTrustPrompt returns false)
A headless provider can still function for basic team orchestration (worker launch, task dispatch, completion)
Unit test: headless submit plan returns expected degraded values
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Headless mode built into CliProviderCapabilities.tui and OpenCodeProvider defaults

acceptanceCriteria: codexHome() replaced with cliConfigHome(provider) that delegates to provider.configHome()

codexPromptsDir() replaced with cliPromptsDir(provider) delegating to provider.promptsDir()
codexAgentsDir() replaced with cliAgentsDir(provider)
projectCodexAgentsDir() replaced with projectAgentsDir(provider) using provider.projectConfigDir()
userSkillsDir() and projectSkillsDir() delegate to provider.skillsDir()
All call sites in the codebase updated to pass or resolve the active provider
No remaining references to ~/.codex/ outside of CodexProvider

userStories.notes: Provider-aware functions added to paths.ts (cliConfigHome, cliConfigPath, etc.). Legacy codex* functions remain as deprecated shims.

mergeConfig() replaced with buildOmxConfig() that returns OmxConfig

userStories.notes: buildOmxConfig() and mergeConfigForProvider() added to generator.ts. Existing mergeConfig/buildMergedConfig preserved for Codex backward compat.

userStories.title: Update omx setup and doctor for multi-provider support
userStories.description: As a user, I need omx setup to configure whichever CLI provider I'm using, not just Codex.
acceptanceCriteria: omx setup accepts --provider <name> flag
When no --provider given, auto-detects installed CLIs from PATH
Setup installs skills/prompts into provider.skillsDir() and provider.promptsDir()
Setup generates config via provider.writeConfig()
omx setup --provider codex --provider claude configures both in one run
omx doctor validates the active provider's binary availability and config integrity
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: setup.ts supports --provider flag with multi-provider config, doctor.ts validates provider binaries in verbose mode
